Fake Call Center Busted in Summit Building; 119 Detained

Lucknow police have busted a large international fake call center operating in the Summit Building. During the operation, 119 people were detained, and two operations managers were arrested. Authorities seized 100 laptops, 178 mobile phones, and a significant amount of digital equipment. The operation involved a 14-hour search by the crime branch and cyber cell.
